system.description:
Smudge (Lavender) (Action): When you hold a lit smudge in both hands, it gives off a strong but pleasant scented smoke. Ranged attacks have 1X Disadvantage against you. The Smudge goes out after 1 minute, with a quick rest, or when you stop holding it in both hands. Expend the Smudge when you use it. (On the sheet: equip it while it burns.)

1 Item Slot (Quickdraw) · 50gc · Baubles, rulebook p.207
